disclosureQuote: Some assets were created with the assistance of generative AI.
summary: 2 至 8 人的答题＋小游戏对战桌游，计划 2026 年 11 月推出。官方披露只写明“部分素材在生成式 AI 协助下制作”，没有说明是哪一类素材，八个领域全部记为披露未说明。
reviewNote: 核查 Steam 英文商店页完整 AI 披露、身份（开发商 Hradba，发行商同名）与英文讨论区首页（可见 4 个主题，总数 4），首页没有与 AI 使用直接相关的主题，未逐帖展开。本款单独检索公开报道 1 次、登记 6 条结果，读取 1 篇原始来源（AI Transparency Index 逐字复刻商店披露的分析页，其内容同样是这句披露的转录，没有补充素材类型）。商店披露原文只有 “Some assets were created with the assistance of generative AI.” 一句，未指明素材类型，因此本条按“范围未说明”登记，八个领域一律不使用“已使用”。结论基于开发者自述，未经独立审计。 本作核查时尚未发售（商店页标注 2026 年 11 月）。
description: 官方披露仅笼统表示部分素材借助生成式 AI，未说明素材类型，AI 使用范围记为未明确。

english.summary: A 2 to 8 player trivia and minigame board game planned for November 2026. The store disclosure only states that some assets were created with the assistance of generative AI, without naming which kind of asset, so all eight areas are recorded as not addressed and the scope is flagged as unspecified.
english.reviewNote: Reviewed the full English Steam AI disclosure, the identity (developer Hradba, self-published) and the English discussion homepage (4 visible topics of 4); no topic concerns AI use beyond the disclosure itself and individual threads were not opened. This title was searched 1 time with 6 results and 1 raw source(s) were read; the AI Transparency Index page reproduces the same single sentence and adds no asset type. The disclosure text does not identify which assets are meant, so no area is recorded as used and the scope is flagged as unspecified. The finding rests on the developer's own statement, without an independent audit. The game had not been released at review time (the store page lists November 2026).
